scope: Recovered implementation is authoritative for manuscript discrepancies by author instruction. The reporting basis uses the May 25 study-era environment archive and recovered HRL-1000/NF-4000 model identities. Final NF/HRL settings were shared except for the respective encoder/policy/decoder snapshots. Author-confirmed model selection and one evaluated policy per reward family are documented; exact cumulative environment-transition totals were not recovered.

author_confirmation.source: User clarification in this conversation following the initial extraction report
author_confirmation.statement: The final NF and HRL trials used the same settings in BP_AgentManager and the other Blueprints; only the encoder, policy, and decoder snapshots generated during their respective training runs were changed.

reporting_basis.environment_selection_reason: Nearest retained commit before the final May 26 evaluation logs; assistant reporting choice stated explicitly in the manuscript under the author's instruction to use recovered implementation

author_model_selection.source: User clarification in this conversation, with a representative TensorBoard screenshot
author_model_selection.search_method: Trial and error across parameter variations
author_model_selection.candidate_selection: Best average-reward candidate selected separately within NF and HRL
author_model_selection.snapshot_selection: Point at which the improvement slope in average reward approached zero
author_model_selection.plateau_assessment: Qualitative; no fixed numerical slope threshold supplied

screenshot.role: Representative dashboard supplied by author; not proof of exact final-run identities or environment-step totals

training_exposure.meaning: Cumulative training represented by a selected snapshot, distinguished from a configured cap, later updates in the same run, and the entire exploratory search
training_exposure.reported_evidence: Snapshot identifiers, qualitative plateau selection rule, and retained optimizer index ranges in training_event_summary.json
training_exposure.manuscript_treatment: Explicitly states unrecovered totals; no invented counts or unresolved fill-in field

evaluation_memory_behavior.registration: LearningAgentsPolicy.OnAgentsAdded initializes recurrent state to zero
evaluation_memory_behavior.training_reset: Learning Agents reset notifications zero recurrent state
evaluation_memory_behavior.custom_phase_trial_reset: Preserves the already registered agent's recurrent memory within the running evaluation session; no policy reset notification in reviewed Blueprint paths
evaluation_memory_behavior.implementation_source: LearningAgentsPolicy.cpp OnAgentsAdded_Implementation and OnAgentsReset_Implementation; retained BP_GameMode/BP_Agent/BP_AgentManager reset graphs

author_observation.measurement_point: BP_AgentInteractor GetFloatAction output / AddControllerYawInput input pin
author_observation.kind: Steering command before controller scaling; not measured actor angular displacement

author_runtime_scale_confirmation.source: User explicitly confirmed runtime scale 2.5 in this conversation

steering_audit.action_model: Continuous Gaussian parameterized by mean and log standard deviation; zero-noise inference selects the mean
steering_audit.float_scale_role: Multiplication when converting the sampled action vector into an action object; not a clamp
steering_audit.yaw_input_formula: RotationInput.Yaw += a_t * InputYawScale when legacy scales are enabled and look input is not ignored
steering_audit.expected_yaw_assumptions: Effective runtime scale 2.5; local PlayerController; look input enabled; one action contribution; standard rotation processing
steering_audit.inference: Observed action magnitudes can reflect the learned policy over visited states; no global network maximum was computed
steering_audit.runtime_check: Scale 2.5 is author-confirmed. Record frame/decision index, action, control/actor yaw at observation gathering and after rotation processing, and action calls per frame; normalize yaw differences and exclude reset frames

tick_timing.input_behavior: Accumulate scaled input; apply in PlayerTick/UpdateRotation; clear in TickActor after processing
tick_timing.retained_blueprint_dependency: Agent actor tick waits for BP_AgentManager actor tick
tick_timing.further_tick_order_trace: Optional troubleshooting; not required to document the recovered implementation
